name: Cantallops (Spain)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the black wolf of the arms.
history: The flag was approved on 20 November 2000 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 3283 of 12 December 2000; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, yellow, with the black wolf of the arms 7/9 of the height at the centre.

features.role: wolf of the arms, 7/9 of the height
